name: GMO Commerce,Inc.
summary: GMO Commerce, Inc. provides marketing support for e-commerce and brick-and-mortar stores. It also develops and provides marketing platforms that support the improvement of store CX and the promotion of DX. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan with an additional office in Miyazaki, Japan. GMO Commerce, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of GMO internet group, Inc.
